title: SXD's Random Blocks
description: Experience the thrill of surprise in Minecraft! This mod adds five tiers of random blocks that drop completely random loot when broken. Blocks are blast-proof, easy to mine, and feature a dedicated creative tab - perfect for survival, building, and servers
body:
## ✨ Mod Overview | 模组概述
A meticulously designed fun mod that adds **five tiers of random blocks** with varying rarity to your game. Breaking these blocks is like opening a treasure chest full of unknowns—you‘ll receive **completely random** item drops, from common resources to rare finds!
一个精心设计的趣味模组，为你的游戏添加了 **五种具有不同稀有度的随机方块**。破坏这些方块就像开启一个充满未知的宝藏——你会获得**完全随机**的物品掉落，从常见的资源到罕见的宝贝都有可能！

## 🧩 Core Features | 核心特性

### 🧱 Five Unique Random Blocks | 五种独特的随机方块
*   **Low Random Block | 低级随机方块**: Drops **1** random item when broken. | 破坏时掉落 **1个** 随机物品。
*   **Medium Random Block | 中级随机方块**: Drops up to **10** random items (1-10 types). | 破坏时掉落最多 **10个** 随机物品（1-10种类型）。
*   **High Random Block | 高级随机方块**: Drops up to **30** random items (1-30 types). | 破坏时掉落最多 **30个** 随机物品（1-30种类型）。
*   **Top Random Block | 顶级随机方块**: Drops up to **64** random items (1-64 types). | 破坏时掉落最多 **64个** 随机物品（1-64种类型）。
*   **Ultimate Random Block | 终极随机方块**: Drops up to **128** random items (1-128 types). | 破坏时掉落最多 **128个** 随机物品（1-128种类型）。

### ⚙️ Smart Technical System | 智能技术系统
*   **Advanced Random Algorithm | 先进的随机算法**: The drop pool includes a vast number of vanilla and modded items, ensuring every break is full of anticipation. | 掉落池包含大量原版及模组物品，确保每次破坏都充满期待。
*   **Intelligent Item Filtering | 智能物品过滤**: Automatically excludes items that should not drop, such as command blocks and barriers. | 自动排除命令方块、屏障等不应掉落的物品。
*   **Performance Optimized | 性能优化**: The drop logic is optimized to minimize game lag. | 掉落逻辑经过优化，尽量避免游戏卡顿。

### 🛡️ Practical Block Properties | 实用的方块属性
*   **Easy to Mine | 易于挖掘**: Same hardness as grass blocks (0.6), can be mined by hand. | 硬度与草方块相同（0.6），空手即可挖掘。
*   **Extremely Blast-Resistant | 极致防爆**: Has extremely high explosion resistance (3600000.0), cannot be destroyed by any explosion. | 拥有极高的爆炸抗性（3600000.0），任何爆炸都无法摧毁。
*   **Convenient Acquisition | 便捷获取**: Any tool (including bare hands) will drop the block itself when breaking. | 任何工具（包括空手）破坏都会正常掉落方块本身。

### 🎨 Thoughtful In-Game Integration | 贴心的游戏内集成
*   **Dedicated Creative Tab | 独立的创造模式分类**: All blocks are neatly organized in the "Random Blocks" creative tab. | 所有方块整齐收录在“随机方块”创造模式标签页下。
*   **Complete Crafting Support | 完整的合成支持**: Features progressive crafting recipes, viewable in the recipe book. | 拥有从简到繁的合成配方，并能在合成书中查看。
*   **JEI/REI Compatible | 兼容JEI/REI**: Easy to look up recipes and usages in-game. | 方便在游戏内查询合成与用法。

## 🧪 Crafting Recipes | 合成配方
All recipes are completed in the crafting table, reflecting a progression from basic to advanced:
所有配方均在工作台中完成，体现了从基础到顶级的进阶设计：

*   **Low | 低级**: 1 Dirt in the center. | 中央放置1个泥土。
*   **Medium | 中级**: Central Dirt + Cobblestone in the top-left. | 中央泥土 + 左上角圆石。
*   **High | 高级**: Central Dirt + Cobblestone top-left + Raw Iron top-right. | 中央泥土 + 左上角圆石 + 右上角粗铁。
*   **Top | 顶级**: Central Dirt + Cobblestone top-left + Raw Iron top-right + Raw Gold bottom-left. | 中央泥土 + 左上角圆石 + 右上角粗铁 + 左下角粗金。
*   **Ultimate | 终极**: Central Dirt + Cobblestone top-left + Raw Iron top-right + Raw Gold bottom-left + Diamond bottom-right. | 中央泥土 + 左上角圆石 + 右上角粗铁 + 左下角粗金 + 右下角钻石。

## 📥 Installation & Compatibility | 安装与兼容
For detailed information on supported Minecraft versions, mod loaders (Forge, Fabric, etc.), and installation instructions, please see the **version info section**.
有关支持的Minecraft版本、模组加载器（Forge、Fabric等）及安装说明的详细信息，请查看 **版本信息部分**。

## ❓ FAQ | 常见问题

*   **Q: Will the drops break game balance? | 问：掉落物会破坏游戏平衡吗？**
    **A:** This is a mod focused on fun and surprise. We recommend server administrators use it with an understanding of its nature, or control accessibility by adjusting crafting recipes. | **答：** 这是一个以趣味和惊喜为核心的模组。我们建议服务器管理员了解其特性后使用，或通过调整合成配方来控制获取难度。
*   **Q: Does it support items from other mods? | 问：支持其他模组的物品吗？**
    **A:** Yes! If other mods are installed, our random drop pool will automatically include their stackable items. | **答：** 是的！如果安装了其他模组，本模组的随机掉落池会自动包含其中可堆叠的物品。
*   **Q: I can‘t find the blocks in Creative mode. | 问：创造模式怎么找不到方块？**
    **A:** Please check your creative inventory. We have set up a dedicated **"Random Blocks"** creative tab category for all our blocks. | **答：** 请查看创造模式物品栏。我们为所有随机方块设置了独立的 **“随机方块”** 分类标签页。

## 🔗 Links & Support | 链接与支持

*   **GitHub Repository | 源代码仓库**: https://github.com/SXD35/SXD-Random-Blocks
*   **Issue Tracker | 问题反馈**: https://github.com/SXD35/SXD-Random-Blocks/issues

---
**Ready to embrace the unexpected? Install the mod now and begin your random adventure!**
**准备好迎接未知的惊喜了吗？现在就安装模组，开始你的随机冒险吧！**
